context: Classify six user supplied contact sheets.
prompt: You are the visual advisor; assess directly, do not delegate. Each attached sheet has 48 chronological frames (6x8) from the owners Tesla. For EACH image, does anything physically touch the recording car? contact=visible physical touch; near_miss=close approach with no visible contact; quiet=nothing approaches; unclear=cannot tell. Do not infer contact merely from proximity. Output one line per image in attachment order: Image N: VERDICT=contact|near_miss|quiet|unclear; ACTOR=who/what or none; CONFIDENCE=low|medium|high; NOTE=up to 12 words. Inspect the beginning of the left side views carefully.
response:
Image 1: VERDICT=quiet; ACTOR=none; CONFIDENCE=high; NOTE=No approach to the recording car is visible.
Image 2: VERDICT=unclear; ACTOR=adjacent SUV’s open driver door; CONFIDENCE=medium; NOTE=Initially open door extends toward Tesla; potential contact point is obscured.
Image 3: VERDICT=unclear; ACTOR=adjacent SUV’s open driver door; CONFIDENCE=medium; NOTE=Initial door edge is very close; glare obscures any definite touch.
Image 4: VERDICT=quiet; ACTOR=none; CONFIDENCE=high; NOTE=Adjacent parked car remains stationary with doors closed.
Image 5: VERDICT=quiet; ACTOR=none; CONFIDENCE=high; NOTE=Adjacent parked car remains stationary; no approach or touch visible.
Image 6: VERDICT=quiet; ACTOR=none; CONFIDENCE=high; NOTE=Vehicle behind remains stationary; no approach or touch visible.
